Collection of standalone development tools for the eap-nova repository.
page_texts.3:
[.utils/README.md#md2pdf---markdown-to-pdf-converter]

### md2pdf - Markdown to PDF Converter

Convert Markdown documents to professionally-styled PDFs with Gainwell branding.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root (works on Windows, Mac, Linux)
cd _tools/md2pdf

# Relative path from tool directory (../../ to go back to repo root)
poetry run python md2pdf.py ../../products/apollo/document.md

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python md2pdf.py /absolute/path/to/document.md

# Show help
poetry run python md2pdf.py --help
```

**Tool Details:** See [md2pdf/README.md](md2pdf/README.md) for installation, features, and troubleshooting.

### pdf2md - PDF to Markdown Converter

Convert PDF documents to Markdown for AI processing and documentation management.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/pdf2md

# Relative path from tool directory (../../ to go back to repo root)
poetry run python pdf2md.py ../../products/apollo/document.pdf

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python pdf2md.py /absolute/path/to/document.pdf

# Specify output location
poetry run python pdf2md.py document.pdf --output ../../docs/output.md
```

**Tool Details:** See [pdf2md/README.md](pdf2md/README.md) for installation, features, and use cases.

### md2docx - Markdown to Word Converter

Convert Markdown documents to Word (DOCX) format with professional styling.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/md2docx

# Relative path from tool directory (../../ to go back to repo root)
poetry run python md2docx.py ../../products/apollo/document.md

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python md2docx.py /absolute/path/to/document.md

# Specify output location
poetry run python md2docx.py document.md --output ../../assets/docs/output.docx
```

**Tool Details:** See [md2docx/README.md](md2docx/README.md) for installation, features, and supported markdown elements.

### docx2md - Word to Markdown Converter

Convert Word (DOCX) documents to Markdown for AI processing and documentation management.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/docx2md

# Convert with image extraction
poetry run python docx2md.py ../../products/apollo/document.docx --extract-images

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python docx2md.py /absolute/path/to/document.docx -i -v

# Specify output location
poetry run python docx2md.py document.docx --output ../../docs/output.md
```

**Tool Details:** See [docx2md/README.md](docx2md/README.md) for installation, features, and conversion details.

### xlsx2md - Excel to Markdown Converter

Convert Excel (XLSX) documents to Markdown for AI processing and data documentation.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/xlsx2md

# Convert Excel spreadsheet
poetry run python xlsx2md.py ../../assets/data/report.xlsx -v

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python xlsx2md.py /absolute/path/to/spreadsheet.xlsx

# Show formulas instead of calculated values
poetry run python xlsx2md.py document.xlsx --show-formulas -v
```

**Tool Details:** See [xlsx2md/README.md](xlsx2md/README.md) for installation, features, and multi-sheet handling.

[.utils/README.md#pptx2md---powerpoint-to-markdown-converter]

### pptx2md - PowerPoint to Markdown Converter

Convert PowerPoint (PPTX) documents to Markdown for AI processing and documentation management.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/pptx2md

# Convert PowerPoint presentation
poetry run python pptx2md.py ../../assets/presentations/deck.pptx -v

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
poetry run python pptx2md.py /absolute/path/to/presentation.pptx

# Split slides into separate files
poetry run python pptx2md.py presentation.pptx --split-slides -v

# Include speaker notes
poetry run python pptx2md.py presentation.pptx --include-notes -v

# Render slides as PNG images (requires LibreOffice)
poetry run python pptx2md.py presentation.pptx --render-slides -v

# Render with custom image prefix
poetry run python pptx2md.py presentation.pptx --render-slides --image-prefix "deck" -v
```

**Tool Details:** See [pptx2md/README.md](pptx2md/README.md) for installation, features, slide rendering, and image extraction.

[.utils/README.md#pptx2pdf---powerpoint-to-pdf-converter]

### pptx2pdf - PowerPoint to PDF Converter

Convert PowerPoint (PPTX) documents to PDF locally using LibreOffice.

**Quick Start:**

```bash
# From repository root
cd _tools/pptx2pdf

# Convert PowerPoint to PDF
python pptx2pdf.py ../../assets/presentations/deck.pptx -v

# Or use absolute path to any file on your system
python pptx2pdf.py /absolute/path/to/presentation.pptx

# Specify output location
python pptx2pdf.py presentation.pptx --output ../../docs/deck.pdf -v

# Convert multiple files
python pptx2pdf.py ../../assets/presentations/*.pptx -v
```

**Tool Details:** See [pptx2pdf/README.md](pptx2pdf/README.md) for installation, LibreOffice setup, and usage.

## Adding New Tools

When adding new tools to this directory:

1. Create a subdirectory: `_tools/newtool/`
2. Include a README.md in the tool directory with installation and detailed documentation
3. Ensure the tool is self-contained and portable
4. Add an entry to this README.md
